decision_conditions: <div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details and full specifications of 2 swift bricks/boxes, and 2 bat boxes and/or tiles, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:</p></div><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 47.25pt;">·&nbsp;&nbsp;A minimum of 2 swift bricks incorporated into the design of the development. They should be installed in groups of at least 2, and placed at or close to eaves level of the development hereby approved. They should be placed at least 5m above the ground with a 5m unobstructed flight path, both below and in front of the swift brick. The swift brick should be located facing north, east, or north east (direct sunlight should be avoided) and should not be placed immediately above doors or windows. Where possible, swift bricks should be set flush into the external wall to match adjacent brickwork.&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 47.25pt;">·&nbsp;&nbsp;A minimum of 2 bat boxes and/or bat roof tiles incorporated into the design of the development. Boxes should be placed at or close to the eaves level of the development and at least 4m above the ground. The boxes/tiles should be placed away from artificial light sources and ideally located near dark tree lines or hedgerows where possible. The boxes/tiles should be located facing south, southeast or southwest, and exposed to sun for part of the day.</p><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">The details hereby approved shall be delivered, in full, prior to the first occupation of the development and shall be maintained for the lifespan of the development.&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">REASON: To support bird and bat populations, including swifts, in Hackney and preserve endangered urban biodiversity.</p></div>

<div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">No development shall commence, other than works of demolition, until a report (including intrusive investigation/trial pit and monitoring where necessary) demonstrating that the basement development will not increase the potential for groundwater flooding to itself or to the surrounding area has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval. Details of appropriate controls including flood resilience and/or resistance measures against surface water (overland flow) and groundwater (if identified) shall be submitted to the LPA for approval and the approved measures incorporated before the basement is occupied. The basement shall be constructed and completed in accordance with the approved plans in line with BS 8102:2022 Protection of below ground structures against water ingress - code of practice.</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">REASON: To ensure adequate drainage of the site.</p></div>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification and a drainage layout of at least one suitable sustainable drainage systems (i.e. water butt, raingarden, bioretention planter box, living roof (substrate depth of 80-150mm excluding the vegetative mat), permeable paving etc.) shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways i.e. plastic modules and soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume for all return periods up to the 1 in 100 year storm events plus an allowance for climate change.&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">REASON: To ensure adequate drainage of the site.</p></div>

<p>Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, precise details of cycle parking shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall, thereafter be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details. The area for cycle parking shall be kept clear of obstruction other than for its intended purpose.<br style=""><br style="">REASON: To promote sustainable transport.</p>

<div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, full details, including installation certificates by an MSC registered installer, must be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority providing full details to demonstrate at least the following standards have been met, as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement (Revision 02 by T16 dated 22/10/2024):&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">a. Solar PV panels annual electricity peak generation of 5 kWp&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thereby approved. Where compliance is not met, a remedial plan and associated cost plan must be prepared and submitted to the Local Authority for approval detailing the necessary measures to meet or improve upon the ‘as designed’ performance. Shortfalls may attract an additional financial contribution to the carbon offset fund.&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction.</p></div>

<div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">Detailed drawings and full particulars of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works. The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved:&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">a. Details of all windows in the form of a 1:20 elevation showing the glazing pattern, together with 1:5 sections showing the material, colour, dimensions and profile of the frames and the depth of the glazing units;&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">b. Details of all external doors in the form of a 1:20 elevation showing the material, colour, dimensions and profile of the doors;&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">c. Details of the rooflights, including a manufacturer’s specification and illustration, together with 1:5 vertical and horizontal cross section drawings showing the location of the rooflight in relation to the roof structure and covering, the frames, and the dimensions of the glazing.&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">d. Details of all rainwater goods in the form of a manufacturer’s illustration and specification showing the design, material, location and dimensions.&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">e. Details of external balustrades including manufacturer’s specification and details of height and fixing.&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest of the Conservation Area.</p></div>

<div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">Full details, including physical samples, of all the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the building, including, but not limited to, brickwork, balustrade and roofing materials, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before any work commences on site. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">&nbsp;</p></div><div style=""><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px;">REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest of the Conservation Area.</p></div>

<div>A Demolition and Construction Management Plan (DCMP) specifying hours of working, construction traffic routing, measures to prevent dust pollution and contact arrangements between residents and contractors shall be submitted and agreed by the Local Planning Authority Prior to the commencement of the development. The CMP shall include the following details:&nbsp;</div><div><br></div><div>(a) loading and unloading of plant and materials;&nbsp;</div><div>(b) storage of plant and materials;&nbsp;</div><div>(c) programme of works (including measures for traffic management);&nbsp;</div><div>(d) provision of boundary hoarding behind any visibility zones;&nbsp;</div><div>(e) wheel cleaning provision on site. Construction shall thereafter take place in accordance with the measures identified within the DCMP.&nbsp;</div><div><br></div><p>REASON: To ensure that during demolition and construction works that there would be no negative amenity or highway impacts as a result of the development. These details are required prior to commencement as they affect the entirety of the construction phase and cannot, therefore, be dealt with retrospectively</p>
application_type_full: Full planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Demolition of existing building fronting Bouverie Road and erection of three-storey building (with basement) to provide extension to pharmacy fronting Stoke Newington Church Street at ground floor and basement levels and two three-bedroom dwellings fronting Bouverie Road.
